name: shutupandlisten-promptfoo
description: promptfoo evaluation harness for the shutupandlisten prompts

scripts.eval: if [ -f ../.env.local ]; then promptfoo eval --env-file ../.env.local; else ../scripts/eval-keys.sh npx promptfoo eval; fi
scripts.eval:smoke: if [ -f ../.env.local ]; then promptfoo eval --env-file ../.env.local --filter-pattern feature-idea --filter-providers 'openai-gpt-4o$' --filter-prompts claude; else ../scripts/eval-keys.sh npx promptfoo eval --filter-pattern feature-idea --filter-providers 'openai-gpt-4o$' --filter-prompts claude; fi
scripts.eval:smoke:ondevice: if [ -f ../.env.local ]; then promptfoo eval --env-file ../.env.local --filter-pattern feature-idea --filter-providers ollama-llama3.2-3b-full --filter-prompts chatgpt; else ../scripts/eval-keys.sh npx promptfoo eval --filter-pattern feature-idea --filter-providers ollama-llama3.2-3b-full --filter-prompts chatgpt; fi
scripts.eval:smoke:replay: if [ -f ../.env.local ]; then promptfoo eval --env-file ../.env.local --filter-pattern feature-idea --filter-providers replay-reading-app --filter-prompts claude; else ../scripts/eval-keys.sh npx promptfoo eval --filter-pattern feature-idea --filter-providers replay-reading-app --filter-prompts claude; fi
scripts.eval:smoke:disfluent: if [ -f ../.env.local ]; then promptfoo eval --env-file ../.env.local --filter-pattern feature-idea --filter-providers openai-gpt-4o-disfluent --filter-prompts claude; else ../scripts/eval-keys.sh npx promptfoo eval --filter-pattern feature-idea --filter-providers openai-gpt-4o-disfluent --filter-prompts claude; fi
